name: momos/platform
description: Momo's Cafe & Halal Restaurant — multilingual website and reservation-request platform (WordPress).

scripts.lint:php: find wp-content/plugins/momos-core wp-content/themes/momos wp-content/mu-plugins tests -name '*.php' -not -path '*/vendor/*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n 50 -P 4 php -d display_errors=stderr -l > /dev/null
i18n:pot: bin/wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/momos-core wp-content/plugins/momos-core/languages/momos-core.pot --slug=momos-core --domain=momos-core --exclude=vendor,languages,node_modules --skip-audit --headers='{"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To":"","Language-Team":"Momos platform team"}'

bin/wp i18n make-pot wp-content/themes/momos wp-content/themes/momos/languages/momos.pot --slug=momos --domain=momos --exclude=assets,static,node_modules --skip-audit --headers='{"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To":"","Language-Team":"Momos platform team"}'
scripts.phpcs:changed: git ls-files -m -o --exclude-standard -- '*.php' | grep -E '^wp-content/(plugins/momos-core/(momos-core\.php|src/|config/|templates/)|themes/momos/|mu-plugins/)' | grep -v '/languages/' | xargs -r phpcs -n -q

scripts-descriptions.lint: Static CI gates: php -l + PHPCS errors in files you changed (working tree) + PHPStan level 5 with baseline (qa.md §3.7, NFR-MNT-01). As root (containers, CI images) Composer refuses to run scripts unless COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1 is set: COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1 composer lint (it otherwise aborts with exit 1 and checks nothing).
scripts-descriptions.lint:php: Syntax-check every PHP file of momos-core, the theme, the mu-plugin and tests.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: Full PHPCS report (WordPress-Extra + PHPCompatibilityWP 8.3, phpcs.xml.dist), warnings included.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs:errors: PHPCS errors only, whole tree (legacy formatting errors included; see composer lint:fix).
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Auto-fix PHPCS formatting violations (phpcbf). Coordinate first: touches many files.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan:baseline: Regenerate phpstan-baseline.neon (only after fixing findings, never to hide new ones).
scripts-descriptions.i18n:pot: Regenerate the momos-core and theme POT files and merge new strings into the Japanese .po files (translate them, then run i18n:mo).
scripts-descriptions.i18n:mo: Compile the Japanese .po files to .mo (checked by tests/phpunit/integration/ToolingI18nPoTest).
scripts-descriptions.phpcs:changed: PHPCS errors (WordPress-Extra + PHPCompatibilityWP 8.3) in modified/untracked PHP files only; CI applies the same rule to the PR diff.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs:security: Escaping / nonce / sanitising / prepared-SQL sniffs over the whole tree (CI: report-only until the wave-2 findings are closed).
